statement: Let I be an open time interval, and let H ∈ C∞(I × [0, 1]) satisfy b(t, x) := 1 + v∗(x)H(t, x) > 0. (2.2) Define v = v∗ + v2 ∗H = v∗b, K(H) = w−1 (wv2 ∗H)′′ , AH =  w−1 (wv2 ∗H)′′′′ . (2.3) At each time these data, together with an affine choice in the Legendre potential, determine a smooth U(n)-invariant Kähler form in [ω∗]. Its scalar curvature and average scalar curvature are S(t, x) = n(n + 1) − K(H)(t, x), S̄ = n(n + 1). (2.4) If, in addition, Ht + (1 + v∗H)2 AH = 0, (2.5) then for any t0 ∈ I and any initial affine choice there is a smooth family of these forms satisfying the Calabi flow exactly. More precisely, its global potential relative to ω(t0) satisfies ϕ(t0) = 0, ω(t) = ω(t0) + i∂ ¯ ∂ϕ(t), ϕt = S(ω(t)) − S̄. (2.6)
